scripts.test: npm run -w power test && npm run -w power-vscode test
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w power typecheck && npm run -w power-vscode typecheck
scripts.build: npm run -w power build && npm run -w power-vscode build
scripts.docs: concurrently -n core,docs -c cyan,magenta --kill-others "npm run -w power watch" "npm run -w docs dev"
scripts.icons:update: npm i -D simple-icons@latest -w power && npm run build && npm run vscode:package
